name: wav2vec 2.0 English alignment model
description: Word alignment model weights (downloaded by the user)
text:
The default English word alignment model is the wav2vec 2.0 "base" model fine-tuned on 960 hours of LibriSpeech (torchaudio bundle WAV2VEC2_ASR_BASE_960H), published by the fairseq authors under the MIT License and redistributed by torchaudio under the same licence. Transcriber does not include it; scripts/setup-diarization.py --alignment downloads it from download.pytorch.org.

The model was trained on the LibriSpeech corpus (https://www.openslr.org/12), which is licensed under CC BY 4.0.
